nodes.label: Paper vs. Live Trading Isolation
nodes.rationale: Paper mode allows safe validation using virtual wallets and DB-only tables, preventing raw exchange order execution. Live mode connects directly to the CoinDCX API and demands credentials encrypted at rest.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL-backed Risk Session Persistence
nodes.rationale: Replaced in-memory Map with DB-backed riskSessionStore so cooldown, drawdown, and consecutive loss states survive restarts.

nodes.label: Simulated Matching Engine & BullMQ Worker
nodes.rationale: Used Redis sorted sets and BullMQ workers to match limit/stop orders asynchronously against tick streams to simulate exchange behaviors accurately in Node.js.

nodes.label: Postgres pgvector Vector Memory
nodes.rationale: Replaced Qdrant vector store with Postgres + pgvector to keep relational episodes and high-dimensional semantic memory in a single database instance.
